en: Job 33

p.src: 1  “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

en: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
u.src: 1  “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

p.src: 2  See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

en: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
u.src: 2  See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

p.src: 3  My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

en: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
u.src: 3  My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

p.src: 4  The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

en: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
u.src: 4  The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

p.src: 5  If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

en: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
u.src: 5  If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

p.src: 6  Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

en: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
u.src: 6  Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

p.src: 7  Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

en: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
u.src: 7  Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

p.src: 8  “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

en: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
u.src: 8  “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

p.src: 9  ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

en: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
u.src: 9  ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

p.src: 10  Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

en: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
u.src: 10  Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

p.src: 11  He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

en: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
u.src: 11  He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

p.src: 12  “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

en: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
u.src: 12  “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

p.src: 13  Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

en: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
u.src: 13  Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

p.src: 14  For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

en: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
u.src: 14  For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

p.src: 15  In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,
u.src: 15  In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

p.src: 16  then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

en: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
u.src: 16  then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

p.src: 17  that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

en: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
u.src: 17  that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

p.src: 18  He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

en: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
u.src: 18  He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

p.src: 19  “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

en: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
u.src: 19  “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

p.src: 20  so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

en: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
u.src: 20  so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

p.src: 21  His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

en: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
u.src: 21  His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

p.src: 22  Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

en: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
u.src: 22  Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

p.src: 23  “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

en: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,
u.src: 23  “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

p.src: 24  then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

en: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
u.src: 24  then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

p.src: 25  His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

en: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
u.src: 25  His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

p.src: 26  He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

en: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
u.src: 26  He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

p.src: 27  He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

en: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
u.src: 27  He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

p.src: 28  He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

en: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
u.src: 28  He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

p.src: 29  “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

en: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
u.src: 29  “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

p.src: 30  to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

en: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
u.src: 30  to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

p.src: 31  Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

en: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
u.src: 31  Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

p.src: 32  If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

en: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
u.src: 32  If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

p.src: 33  If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

en: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
u.src: 33  If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
